item.title: U.S. Air Force refueler crashes in Iraq while supporting Iran war
item.summary: Rescue efforts are ongoing, officials said, after the KC-135 tanker was involved in an apparent accident with another KC-135.

item.title: Former NFL players decry White House video mixing big hits, airstrikes
item.summary: The Trump administration released a video on X using footage of Ray Lewis, Chad Ochocinco and other former NFL players juxtaposed with war footage.

item.title: U.S. sailors injured in fire aboard aircraft carrier supporting Iran war
item.summary: The incident, in a laundry room on the USS Gerald R. Ford, is another setback during the ship’s extended deployment.

item.title: We asked 1,000 Americans if U.S. strikes on Iran should continue. Here’s what they said.
item.summary: Resistance to the U.S. military campaign in Iran is easing overall, though a plurality of Americans still favor ending the strikes.

item.title: Trump touts economic agenda on tour as Iran war stirs prices, GOP dissent
item.summary: The Ohio and Kentucky stops were meant to promote economic gains, but rising oil prices and Republican dissent over Iran threaten to complicate the message.

item.title: Pentagon bars press photographers over ‘unflattering’ Hegseth photos
item.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s staff took issue with photos taken in a rare briefing last week and decided to shut out press photographers from two subsequent news conferences.

item.title: Tracking who Trump is appointing to fill key administration roles
item.summary: Follow President Trump’s progress filling over 800 positions, among about 1,300 that require Senate confirmation, in this tracker from The Washington Post and the Partnership for Public Service.

item.title: Trump’s pick advances in race to replace Marjorie Taylor Greene
item.summary: Clay Fuller, a district attorney, led among Republicans to replace the former congresswoman in deep-red Georgia, while Rep. Bennie Thompson (D-Mississippi) fended off a primary challenge.

item.title: In anti-Muslim post, Tuberville suggests New York’s Mamdani is ‘the enemy’
item.summary: The senator from Alabama, who is running for governor, has previously called for the mass expulsion of Muslims from the United States.

item.title: Rep. Clyburn, 85, to seek reelection amid Democrats’ generational debate
item.summary: The announcement from Clyburn, who turns 86 in July, comes as younger Democrats are challenging the old guard in primaries throughout the country.
